text:
incident-bot: PAGER: P0 - GPU supply chokepoint in prod. Autoscaler hitting max replicas, large queue growth on inference-service, elevated 503s. Paging SRE rotation now. https://internal.monitoring/alerts/3525007777 :rotating_light:

alex: I'm on it. Which regions and pools are affected?

maria: us-west-2 primary. inference-queue-1 backlog x4 in last 8m, 503 rate +12%, p95 latency from 120ms -> 1.2s. Token errors correlate with queue drain time.

oncall-sre: early triage: scheduler failing to place pods due to fragmented MIG availability. Many nodes have leftover 1g slices after prior workload churn, pods request 1xA100-40GB-equivalent (needs contiguous larger slice). Autoscaler requested new nodes but hit pool scale-limit and cloud quota.

kevin: Scheduler logs showing repeated failure: ```E  scheduler: failed to fit pod: no suitable node; reasons: InsufficientMIGProfiles (requested 1x40GB)``` also seeing: ```AdmissionReview: Pod rejected: nodeSelector mismatch + insufficient topology for 40GB slice```

product-ops: Which customers are impacted? any paid Dedicated customers affected?

maria: Two Dedicated tenants experienced throttled requests, one seeing request drop to 60% of expected throughput. CS notified for both. Non-Dedicated traffic experienced increased latencies and some 503s, but no total outages.

alex: Short-term mitigations to try now: 1) deploy model fallback to CPU for non-Dedicated routes (degraded QPS but prevents errors), 2) enable emergency burst policy to allow temporary node overcommit in autoscaler, 3) request manual node add to replenish contiguous large MIG slices, 4) temporarily relax strict MIG-placement constraint for scheduler if safe.

oncall-sre: I'll coordinate manual actions. Creating incident runbook entry and checklist, then escalating to infra to add capacity.

ops-bot: Manual node add request submitted: +3 a100-40gb-equivalent nodes to gpu-pool-usw2 (ticket #INC-9812). Cloud ETA ~7m. Rebalance job queued. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maria: After +3 nodes came up (12m later) queue decreased ~60%. Many backlogged pods placed. Still seeing stranded small slices on older nodes which prevent optimal binpacking; ~8 nodes with 1-2 small MIG slices each.

kevin: Cloud pool hit max earlier which blocked autoscaler. We've requested quota increase; provider responded "under review". For immediate relief I pushed a routing override to send non-critical, non-Dedicated traffic to a lower-cost hosted fallback in us-west-1. Snippet: ```route: inference.default -> if tenantType != dedicated then fallback-usw1```

alex: Mid-term fixes to include in postmortem/action items: - avoid mixing MIG profiles in same autoscaling pool; prefer homogeneous pools per MIG profile - autoscaler to account for fragmentation score and prefer adding uniform nodes not single mixed ones - add emergency runway capacity (reserved burst) for autoscaler to use pre-approved bursts - add preemptive repack job to coalesce small slices during low traffic windows

oncall-sre: Immediate operational steps performed: - enabled burst policy for 20m - manual node add +3 - triggered rolling drain on 8 fragmented nodes to reprovision uniform MIG profiles (will cause transient pod evictions) - routed non-Dedicated traffic to fallback model.

product-ops: CS: notif sent with summary and mitigation ETA, advising customers we'll follow up with RCA. Sent to account owners for the two impacted Dedicated tenants.

alex: Preparing handoff to night oncall @julia at ts 3525007800. Summary and checklist: - backlog reduced but not cleared, keep incident P0 until backlog <10% baseline - keep burst policy active until quota increase or repack completes - watch for eviction cascades during drains - follow up on quota ticket and cloud confirmation - start postmortem doc after stabilization :spiral_calendar_pad:

julia: Acked. Taking over monitoring and communications. Will keep this P0 until backlog <5% and both Dedicated tenants restored to normal throughput. I will update CS and reopen routing if needed.

oncall-sre: Handed off to julia, leaving open tasks in incident doc. Postmortem owners: alex (actions), kevin (cloud quotas), maria (customer comms).

julia: Noting next-day action items: run a test repack on staging to validate rolling reprovision + minimal customer impact; implement fragmentation metric in autoscaler; add canary for relax-placement feature before prod rollback.

incident-bot: Incident P0 escalated -> mitigations in progress, backlog trending down. Runbook entry: https://internal.incidents/3525007777/runbook.

end-of-thread: updated at 3525007900
